legal.termsP1: By using Night Cabinet you agree to platform rules on random draws, inventory allocation, shipping, refunds, and anti-abuse measures. Odds shown at checkout are box-level disclosures; actual draws follow server inventory and published rules.
legal.termsP2: Purchases are limited to users aged 18+. After a box is revealed, refunds are generally unavailable except where required by law or system error (e.g. pity stock failure). Contact in-app support for disputes.
legal.minorP1: Mystery box products involve random outcomes and spending risk. They are not suitable for minors under 18.
legal.minorP2: Parents or guardians must not permit under-18 users to place orders. If you are under 18, decline this app and do not complete purchases.
legal.termsP3: Digital memberships sold on iOS must use Apple In-App Purchase when offered. Physical mystery-box goods may use third-party payment channels where permitted.
legal.termsP4: We may suspend accounts that engage in fraud, chargebacks abuse, or attempts to reverse-engineer draw outcomes.
